title: Find the k-th largest element
summary: Keep only the k best acts in a small room with the weakest by the door; at the end, the act by the door is the k-th best.
goal: Find the score of the k-th best act

mapping.story: The room of the k best

mapping.formal: Top of the heap at the end

examples.label: Six acts, k = 2
examples.explanation: The best is 6 and the second best is 5.

examples.label: Repeated scores, k = 4
examples.explanation: In order: 6, 5, 5, 4. Equal scores count separately.

examples.label: One act
examples.explanation: The only act is the best.

ladder.name: Sort everything
ladder.idea: Sort all scores from best to worst and read position k.

ladder.name: Keep a room of the k best
ladder.idea: Keep a min-heap of at most k scores. Each new score enters; if the room holds more than k, the weakest leaves. The top is the k-th best.
ladder.insight: We never need the full order, only the k best. A small heap that always knows its weakest member does that with less work and memory.

transfer.problem: A sensor streams thousands of readings per second. At any moment, report the 10th highest reading so far.
transfer.explanation: Keep a min-heap of the 10 highest readings; each new reading either beats the top and replaces it, or is ignored.

selfCheck: Uses a min-heap, so the weakest of the best is on top.
Removes the top whenever the heap exceeds k.
Returns the top after all scores.

aka: Kth Largest Element in an Array
